text:
Maya: Heads up — Archipelago asked to reconfirm our Private deployment commitment and go-live window. They expect dedicated VPC + KMS + audit logs by end of Q3. Can we confirm scope/timeline? cc @Derek @Sofia
Derek: They're pushing for Sep 30 target. Signed contract mentions 'production-ready' by end of Q3, but legal flagged data residency. I'm pushing for a 6-week buffer. Any blockers on infra?
Sofia: On infra side, main blockers are: KMS integration testing, private control plane cert rotation, and automation for on-prem package. ETA if we prioritize: 6-8 weeks. Will need a freeze on model changes during rollout.
Liam: We can de-risk with a staged rollout: week1 internal private env, week2 pilot with Archipelago, week3 full cutover. Need to confirm whether they require HSM support (that's +2 weeks).
Priya: Working with Archipelago SRE to validate network controls. They want strict CIDR allowlist + VPN. I have their network contact; can run the checklist Thurs. Sample network config they asked for:```hcl
resource "redwood_vpc" "archipelago" {
  cidr = "10.4.0.0/16"
  kms_key = "projects/archipelago/keys/rdw-kms"
  enable_audit_logs = true
}
```
Anil: Must lock SLA and fallback. If dedicated capacity isn't ready we offer hosted + IP allowlist as temporary. Also ensure billing variance for reserved capacity; @Noah finance signoff needed.
Noah: Finance: need final SOW and headcount estimate. If we add HSM, expect +$18k/month Opex. I'm +1 for staged rollout to avoid penalties.
deploy-bot: Deployment tracker updated — archipelago-private-v1 moved from 'Planning' to 'In Progress' at 1742001800 by Sofia.
Maya: Ok plan: get HSM ask confirmed by EOD Tue; Priya to run networking checklist Thurs; Sofia to start KMS testing Mon. Derek to schedule customer pilot week-of-9/8. If everyone's aligned I'll tell Archipelago we're on track for Sep 30 with canary pilot two weeks earlier. :thumbsup: 
Sofia: Agree. I'll add a canary rollback runbook and the model-freeze notice to release notes.
Liam: I'll queue a canary alert policy in Console and set cost guardrails. Nothing else from product side.
Maya: Thanks team — posting meeting notes to Confluence and will update the account doc. If anything changes tag @Maya for immediate updates.
